text:
kim: Hey team — quick ask: PR #49882 is just a tiny refactor (extract helper, no behavior change). CI is green everywhere except macOS snapshot job which has a nondeterministic UI snapshot failure. I need one reviewer to approve so I can queue a targeted rerun to unblock the merge. TL;DR: approve or tell me if you want a changelog entry.

jon: Can you paste the failing diff?

kim: Sure — failing test is SnapshotTests/testToolbar_render on macos-12. Log snippet:
```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch
Expected: toolbar-icon-3
Actual: toolbar-icon-2
Diff at /build/artifacts/snapshots/...
```
Looks flaky across runs.

ci-bot: Build 8987 failed on macos-12 (snapshot). Targeted rerun allowed after approval by 1 reviewer. Use `/ci rerun targeted 49882` once approved.

mia: I skimmed the PR — code looks fine. Small nit: rename `_makeHelper` -> `makeHelper`. Not a blocker.

tess: @jon can you give a quick 44d or request changes? I have two merges queued behind this.

jon: LGTM. Just the rename nit in a follow-up. :+1: 

kim: Thanks! I'm going to queue the targeted rerun now.

ci-bot: Triggered targeted rerun for PR #49882 on macos-12 (build 8990). I'll post updates.

tess: Thanks, kim. I'll watch the run and merge if green.

ci-bot: Build 8990 PASSED macos-12 snapshot tests. Merge queue updated.

mia: Nice — solid. :tada:

kim: Merged. Thanks all.
